decision.reason: The official Release 4.0 materials describe a whole-body adult-male model and atomic ELEMENT polygon meshes representing anatomy in one reference geometry. The actual local tibialis-anterior and ankle-bone samples decode in one self-contained scene with one node per mesh, but contain no hierarchy, skin, animation, or morph target. No standardized joint posture is declared. Thus the candidate is suitable only as a provisional shared static geometry source, not an animation-ready model or a complete body delivered in this checkout.
